5. 只返回以下结构的合法JSON。
{"scene":{"context_zh":"…","caption_en":"…","caption_zh":"…"},"items":[{"id":"i1","name_en":"…","name_zh":"…","label_en":"…","label_zh":"…","point":[500,500]}]}
